div.h1: ADR 0031 - default basemap must be key-free
div.p: Before #223 every visitor consumed MapTiler quota from first paint.

g.text: AFTER (#223): default is key-free, MapTiler opt-in + capped

text.tspan: RULE: a mode reachable without an explicit operator choice
must never depend on an API key or a monthly quota.
Key rotation = Vercel env + redeploy, always both.
